news.title: LWN.net Weekly Edition for July 2, 2026
news.abstract: Welcome to the LWN.net Weekly Edition for July 2, 2026 This edition contains the following feature content: Xsnow "protestware" in Debian : should distributions allow software with unexpected behavior triggered by a user's locale settings? What's coming in Git 2.55 : a look at some of the interesting features in the latest Git release. Flexible metaprogramming with Rhombus : a new programming language that marries metaprogramming capabilities with a Python-like syntax. Hardening the kernel with allocation tokens and bootpatch-SLR : more efforts to make kernel bugs harder to exploit. Continued coverage from the 2026 Linux Storage, Filesystem, Memory Management, and BPF Summit : Initiating writeback earlier : a discussion on whether to change when writeback is initiated and how that might be done. Efficient access to local storage for BPF programs : two approaches to improving performance for BPF programs. The rest of the 7.2 merge window : more interesting changes coming to the next kernel release. news.summary: LWN.net每周摘要，涵盖Debian中的抗议软件讨论、Git 2.55新特性介绍以及Rhombus元编程语言等相关内容，未涉及Linux内核网络相关主题。
